about.closing:
Idan kuna da sha'awa.
Idan kuna da tunani.
Idan kuna shirye don jinkirin kuma duba kusa —
kuna riga kuna nan.
about.productVisualAlt: An Explorer profile connecting places, books, and ideas worth sharing.

section1.line1: Bincike yana farawa da wayar da kan jiki.
section1.line2: Tare da lura da abin da wasu ke wucewa.
section1.line3: Tare da zaɓar motsi cikin tunani, ba cikin sauri ba.
section1.line4:
Muna rayuwa na ɗan lokaci a duniyar da ta daɗe —
ƙara wasu alamomi na niyya zuwa labari
wanda ya fara tun da daɗewa kafin mu
kuma zai ci gaba daɗewa bayan mun tafi.
section1.title: ABIN DA MUKE YI IMANI

section2.line1: Ba a auna bincike cikin mil.
section2.line3:
Yana rayuwa cikin jinkirin, ba da hankali,
da girmama kowane wuri da muke shiga —
hanya, hanyar dutse, teburin kofi,
ko lokaci da aka raba tare da wani sabo.
section2.title: YADDA MUKE GANIN BINCIKE

section3.item1: Jagororin da aka siffanta ta hanyar ainihin ƙwarewa
section3.item2: Wurare, tafiye-tafiye, sautuna, da labarai masu daraja don tunawa
section3.item3: Al'ummomi da aka gina akan mutane — ba ma'auni na shahara ba
section3.title: ABIN DA MUKE GINA

section4.line1: Masu Binciken Duniya ba kulob ba ne.
section4.line3:
Tunanin da aka raba —
fahimtar shiru na yadda muke tafiya ta duniya.
section4.title: KASANCEWA

subtitle.line2: Bincike, a gare mu, ba game da nisa da muke tafiya ba ne.
subtitle.line3: Game da yadda muke haɗuwa da zurfi.

localTunes.body:
Bincike ba na gani kawai ba ne. Sauti yana ɗaukar ƙwaƙwalwa, mahallin, da motsin rai.

LocalTunes yana ba ku damar tattara kuma raba waƙoƙin sauti don wurare, tafiye-tafiye, da yanayi — ko dai waƙar da aka gano a hanya ko sautunan da ke bayyana wuri a gare ku.

An haɗa shi da bayanin martabar Explorer ɗinku ba tare da katsewa ba.
localTunes.closingStatement: Tunes kyauta ne don bincika, kuma don fasalolin da aka biya za ku iya haɓaka daga baya.

shareAnywhere.subtext:
Hanyar hanyar haɗin ku ta Explorer ta zama jagora mai rai - wani abu da mutane za su iya ajiyewa, sake dubawa, da kuma bincika cikin taki.

Raba shi akan bayanin martaba, saƙo, tebur, bango, ko kati.
Duk inda ya tafi, ra'ayin ku yana tare da shi.

testimonials.headline: Matafiya, masu ƙirƙira, da runduna ke ƙauna

items.name: Priya Sharma
items.quote: masu bincike sun canza yadda nake raba ilimin tafiya na. Mabiya na suna son samun dama ga shawarwari na da aka keɓe!

items.name: Raj Patel
items.quote: Baƙi na suna matuƙar son keɓaɓɓen lambar QR a cikin kayan maraba. Ya zama tabawa na sa hannu!

items.name: Yuki Tanaka
items.quote: Muna raba masu binciken mu tare da abokan ciniki don ba da shawarar sauran wuraren gida. An ƙirƙiri haɗin gwiwar al'umma masu ban mamaki.

items.name: Mariya Silva
items.quote: masu bincike suna taimaka mini in kara gwaninta fiye da sa'o'in yawon shakatawa. Abokan ciniki za su iya samun damar shawarwarina kowane lokaci!

items.name: James Wilson
items.quote: A matsayin mai tasiri na balaguro, masu bincike suna sauƙaƙa raba wuraren da na fi so tare da masu sauraro na. Siffar lambar QR tana da haske!

items.name: Sophie Martin
items.quote: Ina amfani da masu bincike don ƙirƙirar balaguron tafiya ga abokan cinikina. Za su iya bincika QR kuma su bincika cikin taki!

cta.description: Start with the recommendations you already share. Give them one place to live.
cta.title: Make a home for what you would pass on.

hero.description: Whether the point of view is personal, creative, or shared by a brand, explorers gives it a thoughtful home.
hero.title: Different perspectives. One place to share them.
hero.visualAlt: Three perspectives connected through a place, an Explorer profile, and a storefront.

journey.description: The shape changes with the person behind it. The rhythm stays simple.

collect.description: Bring together what you genuinely recommend across the parts of life that matter to you.
collect.title: Collect

shape.description: Organize it with enough context for someone else to understand why it belongs.
shape.title: Shape

share.description: Offer one living link or QR that people can save, scan, and return to.
share.title: Share

journey.title: Three perspectives. One way of sharing with care.

brands.description: Curate the places, products, guides, and ideas that express what your organization genuinely values.
brands.label: Brands
points: Build collections with a clear and human perspective.
Connect locations, products, and useful context.
Give people something thoughtful to save and revisit.
brands.title: Turn your point of view into an experience people can enter.

creators.description: Turn the recommendations scattered across posts, videos, conversations, and notes into something people can return to.
creators.label: Creators
points: Create a durable home for your point of view.
Organize recommendations around stories and themes.
Share through one link or QR wherever people find you.
creators.title: Give your audience more than a feed.

personal.description: Keep the places, books, films, tools, people, and small discoveries you return to in one living collection.
personal.label: Personal
points: Bring different kinds of recommendations together.
Add the context that makes each choice yours.
Share one page that can keep evolving with you.
personal.title: A home for the things that shape your world.

seo.description: See how people, creators, and brands can collect what they value, shape it with context, and share it through one thoughtful Explorer page.
seo.purpose: Help visitors recognize how explorers.earth can hold and share a personal, creative, or organizational point of view.
seo.title: Use Cases | explorers.earth
